# Nexoris Technologies

> Nexoris Technologies designs and builds custom software for businesses in Nigeria and abroad, adding AI where it genuinely helps.

## Services

- [AI Product Development](https://nexoristech.com/ai-product-development/): Websites, apps, and custom software, built around your business
- [AI Chatbots and Virtual Assistants](https://nexoristech.com/ai-chatbots-virtual-assistants/): Answer customers any time, on your website or WhatsApp
- [Business Process Automation](https://nexoristech.com/business-process-automation/): Let software handle the repetitive work
- [AI E-Commerce](https://nexoristech.com/ai-ecommerce-development/): Online stores that sell more, day and night
- [Data Dashboards and Analytics](https://nexoristech.com/data-dashboards-predictive-analytics/): See your numbers live and know what is coming
- [AI and Systems Integration](https://nexoristech.com/ai-systems-integration/): Make the tools you already use share data automatically
- [Data Infrastructure and AI Readiness](https://nexoristech.com/data-infrastructure-ai-readiness/): Clean up your data so reports and AI give right answers
- [IoT Development](https://nexoristech.com/iot-development/): Track your vehicles, machines, and cold rooms live
- [GovTech Platforms](https://nexoristech.com/govtech-platforms/): Digital services for government and public agencies
- [AI Content, SEO and GEO](https://nexoristech.com/ai-seo-geo/): Get found on Google and inside AI tools like ChatGPT
- [Managed Technology Operations](https://nexoristech.com/managed-technology-operations/): We keep your software running and improving after launch
